builds.name: Reference: Contact fighter
builds.goal: Reference for Yorick: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A summon-led side-lane fighter who prepares graves, marks a target for his walkers and traps escape routes. Maiden coordination and his own empowered attack create sustained pressure. Fix graves, Mist Walker count and Maiden targeting. Pet damage and marks must be measured; lethality cannot assume all pets inherit every item passive or on-hit effect. Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage.
testPlan: Kit question for Yorick: Fix graves, Mist Walker count and Maiden targeting. Pet damage and marks must be measured; lethality cannot assume all pets inherit every item passive or on-hit effect.

Start with the early core (Stridebreaker, then Sundered Sky) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Yorick deals bonus damage on his next attack and heals himself. If the target is a champion or large monster or if the target dies, a grave will be dug. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.

Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Physical pressure or sustained contact must justify these purchases; MR and healing slots are matchup dependent.

The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Stridebreaker, then Sundered Sky. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.

kitEvidence.formula:
Yorick's next Attack deals an additional [30 / 50 / 70 / 90 / 110 + (0.5) × AD] physical damage and restores [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=10, perLevel=2, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 3.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 5.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] plus [6 / 7 / 8 / 9 / 10]% of his missing Health, reduced by [50]% against non-Champions. If this Attack hits a Champion or large Monster or kills the target, it leaves a grave.

When there are 3 or more graves nearby and this Ability has already been used, Yorick can Recast to raise Mist Walkers from all nearby graves.

Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist with [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=1050, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 100.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 200.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 250.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.6) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] Health and [50 / 75 / 100 + (0.3) × AD[statFormula=2]] Magic Attack Damage plus [2 / 3 / 4] Mist Walkers. The Maiden automatically raises Mist Walkers from nearby enemy deaths and marks enemy Champions with her attacks. When Yorick damages the Maiden's target, he deals [2 / 2.5 / 3]% max Health magic damage.

After 10 seconds, Yorick can Recast this Ability to free the Maiden, sending her down the nearest lane.
Yorick summons a wall of spirits blocking enemies' path, but not allies'. The wall has [2 / 2 / 3 / 3 / 4] Health and disappears after [4] seconds.

Yorick throws a globule of Black Mist that deals [(6 / 6.5 / 7 / 7.5 / 8 + (0.03) × AP) × (0.01)] max Health magic damage, Slows by [0.3] for [1.5] seconds and marks champions and monsters for [4] seconds. Marked enemies continuously Awaken nearby graves (but not exceeding the maximum of @Spell.YorickPassive:YorickPassiveGhoulMax@) and suffer [(0.13 / 0.16 / 0.19 / 0.22 / 0.25) × 100]% reduced Armor.

Yorick and his summoned units gain [(0.18 / 0.21 / 0.24 / 0.27 / 0.3) × 100]% Move Speed toward the mark. Mist Walkers will leap once at marked enemies that get away from them.

Yorick raises a grave for every [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=8, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 3, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 5, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 7, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] enemies that die near him. Champions and large monsters always leave a grave.

These graves can be used to Awaken Mist Walkers with [characterLevelInterpolation(100 → 300; raw flags preserved) + (0.15) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] Health and [characterLevelInterpolation(15 → 100; raw flags preserved) + (0.2) × AD[statFormula=2]] Attack Damage, up to [4] in an area.
